body_lead: Lalu Yadav releases AI parody video mocking PM Modi ahead of Bihar elections | Watch video PTC Web Desk: In a bold move ahead of the upcoming Bihar Assembly elections, Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) chief Lalu Prasad Yadav stirred political buzz by releasing a satirical video titled “Bihar AI”, which takes direct aim at Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar. The parody video, shared on social media platform X, uses artificial intelligence to generate lookalikes of PM Modi and Nitish Kumar, showing them dancing in the rain before a collapsed bridge.
